CustomField.description: Calculates the number of days since this Opportunity was last touched (any Call, Task, or Event logged against it), using Salesforce's native Last Activity Date. Returns 9999 if no activity has ever been logged. Used to flag stale opportunities, higher numbers mean longer since anyone engaged with this deal. Feeds the "Stale Opportunities, 30+ Days No Activity" report and subscription. Built to replace Airtable's manual Recent Conversations tracking with an automatic, activity-based signal.
CustomField.label: Days Since Last Activity
